title: Promotion Code Terms and Conditions — Online Orders
content:
**1. One code per order.** At most 1 promotion code applies to an Online Orders order, on every delivery service.

**2. Eligible lines.** A code applies only to the eligible lines of the order. It never applies to gift card lines, never to reservations held under Pre-Orders & Back-Orders, and never to final sale lines; it applies to clearance lines only where the promotion register says so.

**3. Percentage codes.** A percentage code discounts each eligible line.

**4. Fixed-amount codes.** A fixed-amount code is spread over the eligible lines in proportion to their price, and each line's share is rounded half up to the cent, the remainder going to the highest-priced line.

**5. Minimum spend.** A minimum spend is tested on the eligible lines' price before discount.

**6. Combining.** Promotion discounts stack with free-shipping waivers, and with Marlowe Rewards Notes and gift cards used as tender, but never with another code.

## What a code combines with

| Alongside a promotion code | Combines |
|---|---|
| A free-shipping waiver on the same order | Yes |
| Payment with a Marlowe Rewards Note | Yes |
| Payment with a gift card | Yes |
| A second promotion code | Never |

## Worked allocation of a fixed-amount code (hypothetical lines)

A fixed-amount code of 40.00 off is applied to an order with three eligible lines of one unit each, priced 110.00, 70.00 and 55.00, which together come to 235.00.

| Line price | Share of 40.00 in proportion to price | Rounded half up to the cent | After the remainder |
|---|---|---|---|
| 110.00 | 18.7234 | 18.72 | 18.73 |
| 70.00 | 11.9149 | 11.91 | 11.91 |
| 55.00 | 9.3617 | 9.36 | 9.36 |
| Total | 40.0000 | 39.99 | 40.00 |

The rounded shares come to 39.99, one cent short of 40.00; that cent goes to the highest-priced line, the 110.00 line, so the allocated discounts total exactly 40.00.

## Worked minimum spend (hypothetical code and order)

A percentage code of 20% with a minimum spend of 100.00 applies to regular-price apparel lines. The order carries a regular-price jacket at 60.00, a regular-price shirt at 45.00 and a gift card line of 50.00. The eligible lines' price before discount is 105.00, which meets the 100.00 minimum; the gift card line is not eligible and does not count toward it. Each eligible line is discounted 20%: 12.00 on the jacket and 9.00 on the shirt.
